---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible RadioMind problem
---

Describe expected and actual behavior, steps to reproduce, OS/CPU architecture,
Python version and RadioMind revision. State whether this is mock or hardware RX.

Include only sanitized errors and synthetic reproductions. Do not attach RF audio,
IQ, archive databases, private profiles, device serials or credentials. Use private
reporting for security issues; see SECURITY.md.
